# EasyFundraise

> EasyFundraise is an AI-powered fundraising workspace for founders raising angel, pre-seed and seed rounds. It helps founders find the right investors, contact them with short personalised emails, track every conversation in a fundraising-native CRM, and stay on top of follow-ups with a personal AI agent.

## Features
- Investor database: 14,900+ investors in 93 countries (angels, syndicates, pre-seed and seed VCs, corporate VCs, family offices), searchable by sector, stage, cheque size, geography, firm type and who leads rounds, or in plain English.
- Fit scoring: investors ranked for your company profile with the reasons.
- Personalised outreach: three-email sequences grounded in each investor's own thesis and deals, sent from the founder's own Gmail, one by one or automatically in each investor's morning send window.
- Safe sending: a spam risk and domain check before scheduling, warm-up and daily limits, follow-ups that stop the moment an investor replies, and bounces that cancel later emails.
- Investor CRM: a fundraising tracker from "Not started" to "Payment received", with reminders, notes, positive replies added automatically and imports from existing spreadsheets.
- Personal AI fundraising agent, a daily brief of follow-ups due, and round or progress update emails to investors already contacted.
- Data room pages that show which investors opened them, what they read and what they downloaded.
- Free task manager for founders, and fundraising resources: pitch decks by stage, AI perks, Y Combinator applications, accelerators and VCs.
- Regions covered: United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Asia (including India and Southeast Asia), the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

## Key pages
- https://easyfundraise.com/ : product overview
- https://easyfundraise.com/legal/privacy : privacy policy
- https://easyfundraise.com/legal/terms : terms
- https://easyfundraise.com/legal/data-sources : data sources and investor rights
- https://easyfundraise.com/investor-request : investors can update or remove their profile
- https://easyfundraise.com/investors : investor lists by country (angel, pre-seed, seed, VC) and by sector
- https://easyfundraise.com/blog : fundraising guides (finding investors, cold email templates, pre-seed vs seed)
- https://easyfundraise.com/glossary : fundraising glossary
- https://easyfundraise.com/free-task-manager : free task manager for founders
- https://easyfundraise.com/legal/cookies : cookie policy
